about.name: Ashwin Keshwaram
about.content: Senior engineer with 16+ years of experience designing, scaling, and operating enterprise web platforms across fintech and content-driven ecosystems. Proven track record of owning end-to-end technical solutions, driving architectural and performance improvements, and influencing engineering practices across globally distributed teams. Extensive experience designing and scaling .NET-based backend systems, complemented by strong experience across modern frontend frameworks and JavaScript ecosystems. Applied cloud-native patterns through serverless architectures and infrastructure as code.

list.company: Fincentric (formerly part of S&P Global; now Communify Fincentric)
highlights: Owned technical design and backend architecture for a large-scale, multi-region, multi-language platform supporting 27 regions, 31 languages, and $2T+ AUM
Acted as primary technical liaison across globally distributed engineering and business teams, translating complex requirements into architectural decisions and execution plans
Improved platform stability and developer velocity by standardizing engineering practices and driving cross-team design alignment across the platform

Drove platform-wide performance optimizations by redesigning caching strategies, tuning Solr indexes, optimizing renderings, and eliminating redundant SQL calls, resulting in ~30% improvement on high-traffic pages
Designed and implemented custom Sitecore pipelines to support complex workflows, role-based experiences, and extensibility requirements
Established observability and monitoring practices (Grafana, Kibana) to proactively identify performance bottlenecks and production issues
Led development of a public-facing fintech web application using React + Node.js backed by SQL Server, supporting high-visibility client use cases
Delivered high-visibility features overseen by company leadership, driving predictable execution under tight timelines and external scrutiny
Contributed to the design and implementation of headless Sitecore JSS architecture for arrow.com using .NET, Angular, and TypeScript
Built reusable Sitecore components enabling content editors and marketers to rapidly create high-traffic, revenue-critical pages
Improved platform stability and developer velocity through consistent coding standards and collaboration with cross-functional teams
Designed and delivered 100+ reusable Sitecore components across multiple high-profile enterprise client websites
Owned Sitecore Experience Editor optimizations, significantly improving the content authoring workflow for non-technical users
Participated in architectural discussions, peer code reviews, and cloud deployment strategies for Sitecore-based platforms hosted in Azure

list.location: Somerville, MA, USA & Raleigh, NC, USA
highlights: Built and scaled Sitecore applications from scratch using .NET MVC, WebForms, Angular, and Backbone, supporting enterprise content platforms
Led Sitecore version upgrades using migration tools, ensuring minimal downtime and backward compatibility
Designed custom authoring workflows and implemented automated unit testing, reducing production defects and improving release confidence
Designed and delivered reporting and analytics features for a large-scale education assessment platform used by state, district, and school stakeholders
